messages:
ashley: Heads-up  new launch asset request: we need a compact "bench spotlight" kit for the upcoming webinar and socials. Deliverables: three 600x600 tiles (latency, cost, quality), 600x200 email header, 16:9 slide, SVG icon pack, and a 2s animated GIF. Mobile-first. Deadline: Wed EOD.
maria: Scope noted. Please make tiles modular so we can swap copy in-prod. Also include a tiny 6-node signup->nurture->webinar microflow for the slide.
diego: For charts: prefer unified sparkline style + p95 label. Cost tile should show relative unit cost vs baseline (no absolute $).
kevin: I'll start the Figma file and add tokens. Any palette constraints?
maria: Use brand navy + accent orange for deltas. Legal flagged low contrast last quarter so ensure AA for 12px labels.
legal: Confirmed. Avoid absolute superlatives. Use "latency-optimized" / "cost-efficient". Add methodology blurb with link; mark any numbers as p95/p50.
l10n: For FR/JA, include a CSV exportable string layer and keep CTAs under 20 chars. Provide context notes for translators.
diego: Plan: PNGs, SVGs, GIF; include accessible alt text copy in a text layer. Will provide separate asset pack for email.
design-bot: Created task FIGMA-1678 "bench-spotlight-kit". Owners: @kevin, @diego. Due 2025-05-14.
kevin: Uploaded starter: https://figma.com/file/bench-spotlight-1678. Artboards: tiles, slide, icons. First pass by Tue noon PT.
maria: Great. Ping here when ready for a quick 20-min review. This pack feeds webinar slide deck, launch socials, and inbound email flows. :rocket:
